hero_title: Unleash the superpower of creating technology!
hero_subtitle: At codear.la we teach children, teens, and adults how to program, build intelligent robots, and solve problems using technology.
benefits_subtitle: At codear.la kids don't just come to have fun. We focus on transmitting real knowledge that will benefit them in their studies, no matter what path they choose.
benefit1_desc: They learn to break down complex problems into simple steps, structuring their minds in an orderly and analytical way.
benefit2_desc: They transition from screen consumers to creators of their own technology, programming their own games and animations.
benefit3_desc: They work on cooperative projects, boosting essential soft skills such as empathy, communication, and leadership.
cta_title: Ready to take the first step?
cta_desc: Our registration for courses and workshops is open, write to us and we will contact you. You can also write to us for private tutoring or customized experiences.
